name: Qatar Central Bank — Technology Risk Circular

official_sources.title: Qatar Central Bank — Technology Risk Circular (Cyber Security & IT Risk)
QCB Instructions to Banks (relevant cyber-risk obligations)
Methodology: ISO/IEC 27005:2022 - Information security risk management
Reference: Basel Committee — Principles for the sound management of operational risk

methodology: The QCB Technology Risks Circular mandates Qatari licensed banks (and selected non-bank financial institutions) to implement a documented cyber-security and IT-risk programme covering ten organisational domains. Each control is assessed against board-approved risk appetite, with residual risks rated on QCB's 5-point likelihood × impact matrix. Material findings are reportable to QCB; the regulator requires annual self-assessment, third-party penetration testing, and prompt notification of significant cyber incidents. The methodology follows ISO/IEC 27005 risk-management process — context, identification, analysis, evaluation, treatment, communication and monitoring — anchored to the Circular's organisational, technical and procedural requirements.

scoping_inputs.label: Critical banking systems in scope (core banking, payments, online channels)
Material outsourcing arrangements (cloud, managed services, SWIFT bureau)
Date of most recent independent penetration test

likelihood.label: Rare
likelihood.definition: May occur only in exceptional circumstances (<5% per year).

impact.label: Insignificant
impact.definition: Negligible impact on banking operations / customer trust.

impact.label: Minor
impact.definition: Limited service disruption; no customer harm; no regulator notification required.

impact.label: Moderate
impact.definition: Notable service disruption or limited customer data exposure; QCB notification required.

impact.label: Major
impact.definition: Significant customer impact, settlement disruption or material fraud; formal QCB reporting and remediation directive expected.

impact.label: Severe
impact.definition: Systemic event — payment-system disruption, mass customer fraud, loss of QCB confidence; risk to licence.

risk_model.calculation: likelihood * max(impact_c, impact_i, impact_a, impact_financial, impact_regulatory, impact_reputation)

controls.title: Board-approved cyber security function and framework
controls.description: Establish and maintain a board-approved cyber-security function, framework and governance structure proportionate to the institution's size and risk profile.

questions.prompt: Implementation status of board-approved cyber framework?
Is a designated CISO (or equivalent) appointed and reporting to the board?
Frequency of board-level cyber risk review.
Evidence (board charter, CISO appointment letter, committee minutes).

controls.title: Cyber risk appetite and tolerance
controls.description: Define, document and approve a cyber-risk appetite and tolerance aligned with overall enterprise risk appetite.

questions.prompt: Quantitative metrics defined for cyber-risk appetite (e.g. max tolerable downtime, max acceptable fraud loss).
Recent appetite breaches and remediation actions.

controls.title: Identity and access management
controls.description: Implement role-based access, segregation of duties, privileged access management and multi-factor authentication for all sensitive systems.

questions.prompt: MFA coverage on privileged accounts (%) and customer-facing channels (%).
Privileged access management solution in use.

controls.title: Network and endpoint security
controls.description: Layered network security including segmentation, firewalls, IDS/IPS, DDoS protection, EDR and DNS filtering.

questions.prompt: Network segmentation strategy (zones, DMZ, OT vs IT).
EDR coverage on endpoints (%) and servers (%).

controls.title: Secure software development lifecycle
controls.description: Apply secure-by-design SDLC to all in-house and outsourced banking applications including code review, SAST/DAST and pre-release security testing.

questions.prompt: SDLC artifacts (threat models, SAST/DAST reports, vendor security reviews).
Change-management process for production banking apps.

controls.title: Online and mobile banking security
controls.description: Implement strong customer authentication, transaction signing, anti-fraud monitoring and secure communication for online / mobile channels.

questions.prompt: Strong customer authentication method (OTP, push, biometric).

controls.title: Patch and vulnerability management
controls.description: Maintain a documented vulnerability-management programme with risk-prioritised patching SLAs and independent verification.

questions.prompt: Internal and external vulnerability scan frequency.
Date of last independent penetration test.

controls.title: Logging, monitoring and SOC
controls.description: Centralised logging, 24x7 SOC monitoring and SIEM correlation across critical banking systems.

questions.prompt: Number of log sources feeding SIEM and retention period.

controls.title: BCM and disaster recovery programme
controls.description: Documented BCM and DR programme with RTO/RPO objectives for critical banking services and at-least-annual exercise.

questions.prompt: RPO for core banking system (minutes / hours).
Date of last full DR exercise.

domains.name: 6 — Cyber security in the Risk department

controls.title: Integrated cyber risk management
controls.description: Cyber risk is integrated into the enterprise risk management framework with consistent taxonomy, reporting and treatment processes.

questions.prompt: Cyber-risk register location and last update date.

domains.name: 7 — Cyber security in the Procurement department

controls.title: Third-party security risk management
controls.description: Conduct pre-engagement security due diligence, contractual security obligations, ongoing monitoring and exit assurance for material vendors.

questions.prompt: Vendor risk-tiering criteria and number of critical vendors.
QCB pre-notification process for material outsourcing in place?

domains.name: 8 — Cyber security in the Legal and Compliance department

controls.title: Regulatory reporting and incident notification
controls.description: Maintain a documented process for prompt notification of significant cyber incidents to QCB and other regulators.

questions.prompt: Internal SLA for QCB notification (hours after detection).

domains.name: 9 — Cyber security in the Human Resources department

controls.title: Personnel security and awareness
controls.description: Apply background checks, role-based security training, security clauses in employment contracts and exit procedures.

questions.prompt: Phishing simulation frequency and click-through rate.

controls.title: Annual self-assessment and independent review
controls.description: Conduct an annual self-assessment against this Circular plus an independent review at the cycle defined by QCB; remediation plans tracked to closure.

questions.prompt: Date of last independent third-party review.
Number of open findings by severity.
